statement_on_data_immutability: Raw data was inspected strictly in read-only mode and was NOT modified, overwritten, or cleaned in-place.

locked_treatment_policy.deduplication: Exact duplicate rows removed using drop_duplicates(keep='first') before feature extraction.
locked_treatment_policy.customer_eligibility: Customer ID must be non-null. Customer must have >= 1 commercial purchase.
locked_treatment_policy.commercial_purchase_event: Invoice does NOT start with 'C', Quantity > 0, Price > 0, Customer ID is non-null.
locked_treatment_policy.commercial_monetary_value: line_value = Quantity * Price on commercial purchase rows.
locked_treatment_policy.cancellations: Invoices beginning with 'C' excluded from purchase events and future return targets. Stored in descriptive cancellation table.
locked_treatment_policy.anonymous_transactions: Missing Customer ID rows excluded from customer-level modeling.
locked_treatment_policy.zero_price_rows: Price == 0 excluded from commercial purchase and monetary definitions.
locked_treatment_policy.non_c_negative_quantities: Excluded from commercial customer analytics (missing Customer ID, zero monetary value).
